# DTCG 2025.10 schema fixture

`format.schema.json` is the official bundled JSON Schema for the Design Tokens
Community Group format specification, version 2025.10.

- Source: <https://www.designtokens.org/schemas/2025.10/format.json>
- Retrieved: 2026-07-23
- SHA-256: `32e93b780e4e4bca778d0780cb797a560deedc470c608af16576223f7e42915f`

The fixture is committed so conformance tests remain deterministic and do not
depend on network availability. To update it, choose a new published DTCG
version deliberately, download its bundled schema, record its source and
checksum here, then update both the transformer `$schema` value and the
conformance tests in the same change.
